flatRemainders.realization: compare to one fixed finite residual; never sum E_j

algebra.conclusion: If the original initial state and the four original updated-current maps satisfy their stated class hypotheses, every complete cycle improves wave, full tangential mean and current defect orders by exactly 1/10 on the same domain.

physical.KRequiredPremise: The original normalized background and complete current have the all-fixed-order polynomial-S amplitude bounds used in Lemma9.8.
physical.cutoffProof: Every derivative of chi(a*q) is bounded by C*q^(-m), independent of a, because a*q is bounded on its derivative support and 0<D<1. The full curl needs one more potential derivative; ell_(m+1)+(m+1) is sufficient.

dependencies.recurrence: D_(v,a)(m)=max_(w->v) D_(w,a)(m+d_(v,w)); source a needs m; an absent source contributes no request.

logarithmicConversion.comparison: ell<=C*(1+abs(log(q))) on every admitted fixed-neighbor dyadic chart
logarithmicConversion.operatorProducts: multiply constants and add S powers; Leibniz sums take maxima of all mixed derivative powers and retain their binomial counts in the constant
logarithmicConversion.missing: Actual source-specific majorant and S-degree leaves for the full updated-current sequence.

finiteHarmonicRange.meaning: The wave field starts at |m|<=1 and its residual at |m|<=2. Each complete cycle adds only existing residual modes; its new quadratic residual at most doubles the range.

flatSourceOrderRequest.meaning: A separate fixed-stage original integration-by-parts majorant must request every source derivative needed for the selected q^N flat bound.

program.residualSamplePolicy: If one sampled residual grows, inspect interval precision, covered domain, complete terms and constants. An asymptotic exponent inequality does not assert monotone finite-sample residual norms.

checks.argument: T=exp(Md)+10>10, hence 0<h=exp(-8002T)<exp(-4)<1/16, using e>2. No binary floating-point value is assigned to h.

sourceReferences.role: All four ordered updates, full covariance and residual exponent inequalities
One domain, finite derivative requests, phase and physical losses
Actual source majorants needed before a final cutoff/tail schedule can be instantiated

remainingObligations.required: Bind Prop9.5 class estimates to the authenticated initial temporal -> new pressure/current moments -> five-map -> final pressure sequence.
remainingObligations.missingValue: Original input-current weighted seminorms and corresponding all-order S powers.

remainingObligations.required: Bind the exact forced inverse to every actual residual coefficient and full pressure/conjugate/curl/current update.
remainingObligations.missingValue: Complete same-source cycle body and joint derivative/closure dispatcher.

remainingObligations.required: Instantiate all finite derivative requests in this operation DAG with source-only norm generators and exact Gaussian/reciprocal/polynomial-S bounds.
remainingObligations.missingValue: C_(j,m), P_(j,m), cutoff C-hat_(j,m)/P-hat_(j,m) and every fixed-stage flat C_(j,m,N).

remainingObligations.required: Use those authenticated majorants to choose the common a_j and certify active indices and omitted tail on the selected evaluation window.
remainingObligations.missingValue: An original final-field schedule and its source-bound field/potential evaluator.
